# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Over fifty years old  <sub>[v1 c9 P44](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0044)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Role:** Homemaker and farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P1](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0001), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a tall, slender woman with sharp angles rather than curves. She has dark hair interspersed with gray strands, which she wears bound tightly at the back in a firm bun pierced combatively with wire hairpins. She possesses sallow cheeks, a sharp-featured face that becomes leaner with age, and a redeeming mouth that suggests a hidden sense of humor.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c13 P11](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0011), [v1 c33 P15](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0015), [v1 c37 P2](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0002)_

## Personality

Thirza possesses a limited background and an unyielding sense of morality, maintaining strict standards of propriety, tidiness, and religious duty. Though she is initially sharp, abrupt, and reserved, she has a hidden sense of humor and a deep capacity for affection. She is intensely practical, disdains romantic daydreams, and expresses her love through caretaking rather than words.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P13](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0013), [v1 c4 P10](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0010), [v1 c7 P1](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0001), [v1 c7 P19](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0019), [v1 c10 P50](../source/v01-c10.md#nw-v01-c10-p0050), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003)_

## Goals

- To raise Nell properly in a moral and Christian household  <sub>[v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c6 P34](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0034), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029)</sub>
- To maintain Grey Shutters as a home and avoid selling it  <sub>[v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023)</sub>

## History

Thirza Abernethy lived a quiet life at Grey Shutters in Brierley with her brother Obed. Expecting an orphan boy from Nova Scotia to help on the farm, they were surprised when an orphan girl, Nell Harcourt, arrived instead due to a mix-up. Though Thirza initially planned to return Nell, she decided to keep her out of compassion and a desire to give her a proper Christian upbringing. Over the years, Thirza strictly raised Nell, teaching her domestic skills and moral behavior while coming to love her as her own child. When her brother Obed died suddenly following a bank failure, Thirza was left devastated and faced financial ruin. Her deteriorating eyesight threatened her independence, making her consider selling Grey Shutters, but Nell gave up her college scholarship to stay home, teach school, and care for Thirza. Eventually, Thirza invited her lifelong friend, Mrs. Agatha Sowerby, to live with her at Grey Shutters, enabling Nell to finally attend Wexcombe College.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P16](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0016), [v1 c3 P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c7 P29](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0029), [v1 c30 P3](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0003), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020), [v1 c38 P4](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0004), [v1 c38 P14](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0014), [v1 c38 P20](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0020), [v1 c38 P23](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0023), [v2 c26 P15](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0015), [v2 c26 P23](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0023)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a bashful, quiet farmer who built Grey Shutters  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with John Carrow that ended after an argument  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v1 c37 P40](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0040)</sub>
- Inherited an amethyst brooch from her mother, which was brought by her sailor uncle  <sub>[v1 c13 P20](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0020)</sub>
- Lived her whole life at Grey Shutters in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c8 P11](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0011), [v1 c28 P42](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0042)</sub>

## Quotes

> As long as you live in my house, Nell, it is required that you say your prayers.  <sub>[v1 c7 P14](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0014)</sub>

> I refuse to hold with picturing things other than how they actually exist. If the Lord places us in particular situations, His intent is not for us to pretend they do not exist.  <sub>[v1 c8 P19](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0019)</sub>

> Agatha, it was wrong of you to mock her appearance.  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026)</sub>

> My love for you is as deep as though you were my very own child, and from the moment you arrived at Grey Shutters, you have brought me nothing but happiness and solace.  <sub>[v1 c37 P20](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0020)</sub>
